correctness.rationale: The discrete model is valid for two particles on the sufficiently subdivided Petersen graph. Exact reconstruction gives chain ranks C_0=45, C_1=120, C_2=75 and verifies ∂_1∂_2=0. A spanning-tree presentation gives a 76×75 matrix M; rank mod 2 is 69, rank mod 3 is 70, and a certified 70×70 minor has determinant ±2, forcing Smith product 2 and H_1≅Z^6⊕Z/2. Five explicit integral 2-cycles have a unimodular 5×5 row minor, forcing H_2≅Z^5. All 120 S_5 actions are replayed exactly, and their traces match the stated characters.

General first-homology theorems may already imply the nonequivariant H_1 abelian group; originality is therefore attached to the combined degree-one/degree-two S_5-module statement, not to H_1 rank/torsion in isolation.

value.rationale: The Petersen graph is a canonical smallest highly symmetric non-planar cubic graph, while the inspected graph-configuration literature explicitly identifies non-planar H_2 as a structural gap. Determining the full S_5 action records substantially more information than Betti numbers: the degree-one and degree-two free homology are distinct irreducible representations, and the integral first homology also contains a symmetry-fixed Z/2 class. This gives a compact exact benchmark for unstable non-planar graph-configuration topology and for equivariant calculations.
